timing_note: Retrospective reanalysis protocol fixed before this script aggregates results; existing outcomes were already known. This is not a prospective preregistration. The strict rule was selected by the author for consistent cross-model reporting.

primary_scoring.strict_invalid: Use archived terminal strict failure flags, verify against raw result error/status fields. All three binary metrics are zero on a strict-invalid output. Do not rescue selected metrics from that output.
primary_scoring.missing: Missing/infra/nonterminal records are audit errors, never silently imputed as strict failures.
primary_scoring.compression: 1 - unique selected node count / SCC size, only for defined valid outputs; report its denominator.
primary_scoring.binary_denominator: All 80 planned variants for each model-method.
primary_scoring.partial_local_fallback: Preserve the frozen within-rollout parsing fallback: a valid terminal system output remains valid even if some local windows used fallback. Report this boundary; do not retrospectively redefine it.

sensitivity: Keep Qwen3.5 archived metricwise re-parsing as a separately labeled sensitivity; do not combine its policy with strict primary scores. No new response selection or raw re-parsing.

bootstrap.unit: physical source SCC; all paired models, variants and methods from a source travel together
bootstrap.overall: Compute SA-minus-baseline per variant and model, average the 20 differences in each physical source, then average the 20 sources. Models are fixed, not resampled.
bootstrap.per_model: Average four within-source variant differences, then average 20 sources.
bootstrap.sample: 20 indices with replacement for each replicate, shared across comparisons
bootstrap.interval: percentile 2.5 and 97.5 using linear interpolation at (n-1)*p
bootstrap.multiplicity: No adjustment; intervals are descriptive and not a multiple-hypothesis claim.
bootstrap.compression_ci: Separate complete-pair conditional analysis only; sources with no jointly valid pair omitted, source-equal means over available paired outputs; label denominators and selection limitation.

limits: One frozen terminal output per method-model-variant; retries inside the archived execution remain part of that outcome.
Mixed historical execution batches; no contemporaneous full-cohort attribution.
Bootstrap captures selected-source heterogeneity, not inference-run seed variance, unseen-model variance or natural-risk prevalence.
No new model calls. No edits to raw results or prior accepted summaries.
